title: Sprint 7 - Advanced Aggregation & Math
description: Complete all SQL queries in this sprint.

tickets.title: User's Todo List
tickets.description: The front-end needs to display the task title alongside the username. Join the tables to fetch `username` and `title`. Use aliases `u` for users and `t` for todos.
tasks: The front-end needs to display the task title alongside the username. Join the tables to fetch `username` and `title`. Use aliases `u` for users and `t` for todos.
learning_objectives: Master the INNER JOIN and Aliases.
hints: Use `users u` to alias the table to `u`.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT u.username, t.title FROM users u INNER JOIN todos t ON u.id = t.user_id ORDER BY u.username, t.title;

tickets.title: All Users and Their Tasks
tickets.description: Get a list of ALL users, along with their tasks. If a user hasn't created any tasks, they should still appear in the list with a NULL task title. Use table aliases.
tasks: Get a list of ALL users, along with their tasks. If a user hasn't created any tasks, they should still appear in the list with a NULL task title. Use table aliases.
common_mistakes: Using INNER JOIN instead of LEFT JOIN.
hints: Read the SQLite documentation for the specific keyword.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT u.username, t.title FROM users u LEFT JOIN todos t ON u.id = t.user_id ORDER BY u.username, t.title;
